9848: Idaho Power park on 65 acres on the Idaho side of Brownlee Reservoir, 23 miles northwest of Cambridge on Idaho Highway 71: four camping loops with 118 RV sites (water and 30-amp power) and 15 walk-in tent sites, showers, a dump station, fire rings, a four-lane boat ramp and docks, a fish-cleaning station and a paved walking path.  Camp hosts are on site from early April to Labor Day.  Utility-run, so ownership is private. --Claude
10641: Jackson County park overlooking Lost Creek Lake on the Rogue River, about 40 miles from Crater Lake National Park: 151 sites with water and power (some in B Loop have a lake view), 50 water-only sites in D Loop, flush toilets and hot showers, a dump station, a fenced off-leash dog area, a playground, and hiking trails and bike paths.  The Joseph Stewart Resort in the day-use area has a camp store, a small café and a marina that rents boats and moorage, typically from mid-April through October.  Oregon State Parks discounts and waivers haven't applied since Jackson County Parks took over on April 1, 2021. --Claude
11014: Primitive Linn County park on 328 forested acres on Green Peter Reservoir near Sweet Home, 12 miles from the intersection of Hwy. 20 and Quartzville Road: sites without hookups (four are double pull-throughs for 2 RVs), yurts, vault restrooms and hand-pump water.  The boat ramp, within a mile, can't be used once the reservoir drops below 972 ft, which often happens early in the season. --Claude
11033: Linn County park on 90 acres on the banks of the upper South Santiam River, off Highway 20 near Foster and Sweet Home: 85 campsites with and without water and power, cabins, yurts, group camping, restrooms with showers, a dump station, a playground, a dog run, hiking trails and river access for swimming and fishing. --Claude
11037: Josephine County park on 24 acres on the Rogue River at 605 Schroeder Lane, 4.5 miles from Grants Pass: 22 full-hookup sites (50-amp), 22 tent sites (some take an RV without hookups), a group tent site and a yurt, a heated restroom with showers by the hookup sites, a boat ramp, a fishing platform, tennis and basketball courts, a playground and a dog park split for small and large breeds. --Claude
11057: Josephine County park on 27.9 acres on the Rogue River at 14800 Galice Road near Merlin, 24.3 miles from Grants Pass: 38 tent sites, two of them pull-throughs that take a fully self-contained RV, two group tent sites, two yurts, a vault toilet, a boat ramp and a park host selling firewood and ice.  There is no cell service. --Claude
11058: Josephine County park on 61 acres on the Rogue River at 7100 Galice Road near Merlin, 16.2 miles from Grants Pass: 32 full-hookup sites (50-amp), 18 with water and power, and 30 tent sites, 23 of them on parking spurs an RV fits; two yurts, a group tent site, three restrooms (two with showers), a boat ramp, horseshoe pits, a 9-hole disc golf course and the Sims picnic shelter for up to 200.  There is no cell service. --Claude
11082: Josephine County park on 300 acres around Lake Selmac, the county's only lake, near Selma, 24.5 miles from Grants Pass: 34 full-hookup sites (50-amp) and 2 with water and power in the Osprey and Mallard loops, 44 tent sites across five loops (12 take a self-contained RV), five yurts and a horse camp with corrals.  Osprey Loop has the restroom and showers; Heron, Teal and Eagle loops have vault toilets.  ODFW designates the lake a Trophy Bass Lake; the park also has disc golf and horseshoe pits. --Claude
11083: Former Cascadia State Park, now a Linn County park, where Soda Creek meets the South Santiam River on Hwy. 20 east of Sweet Home: 23 sites without hookups (35 ft at most, two vehicles), a glamping tent, two group tent areas, flush toilets, showers and an off-leash pet area.  A three-quarter-mile trail leads to Soda Creek Falls, and ruts of the historic Santiam Wagon Road are visible in the park. --Claude
11084: Linn County park and marina on Hwy. 20 at the southwest corner of Foster Reservoir, just east of Sweet Home: 49 full-hookup RV sites (30- and 50-amp) on paved pads with lawns, a laundry, restrooms and showers, and 40 boat slips that only campers can rent.  No tent camping. --Claude
11089: Jackson County park on 33 acres at 27766 Highway 62 in Trail, 29 miles northeast of Medford, with three-quarters of a mile on the upper Rogue River: 16 electric sites and 22 without hookups, restrooms, a playground and a 2-lane boat ramp. --Claude
11096: Josephine County park on 80 acres on a creek near the historic Wolf Creek Inn, at the end of Main Street off I-5 exit 76: 14 RV sites with water and power, 18 tent sites and 2 group tent sites, vault toilets, a picnic shelter, disc golf, a small playground, a seasonal swimming hole and a trailhead to the top of London Peak. --Claude
11100: Jackson County park on 155 acres on the west shore of Howard Prairie Lake, a Reclamation reservoir 21 miles east of Ashland: 1.63 miles of lake frontage and views of Mt. McLoughlin, 112 basic sites, 80 with water and power and 51 with full hookups, free showers, a dump station, fish cleaners, an accessible fishing jetty, a store and restaurant, a marina that rents boats, and hiking trails. --Claude
